review_locator: PMCID:PMC3313690, Interleukin-5 and IL-5 receptor in health and diseases
primary_title: Granulocyte macrophage colony-stimulating factor and interleukin-5 activate STAT5 and induce CIS1 mRNA in human peripheral blood eosinophils
decision_basis: The review-guided primary reports rapid IL-5-induced STAT5 tyrosine phosphorylation and GAS DNA-binding activity in human peripheral-blood eosinophils.
limitations_preserved: Promote as an evidence-skipped IL-5-to-STAT5 bridge alongside the existing IL5RA:CSF2RB receptor-complex→STAT5 edge; preserve eosinophil context and do not infer a universal cytokine mechanism or SCI relevance.

primary_title: Granulocyte macrophage colony-stimulating factor and interleukin-5 activate STAT5 and induce CIS1 mRNA in human peripheral blood eosinophils
decision_basis: The review-guided primary reports enhanced transcription of the STAT5-dependent cytokine-inducible SH2 protein/CIS1 gene after IL-5 stimulation of human peripheral-blood eosinophils.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-5-associated CISH gene-output bridge; preserve the eosinophil model and distinguish CISH transcript output from direct STAT5 promoter occupancy or terminal-TF inference.
